name: Email Automations Using DeepSeek 🐋
description_md:
What You’ll Get:

- 
Step-by-Step Setup Guide:
Learn how to install and configure the new Make.com module that integrates Gmail with DeepSeek Chat and DeepSeek R1 models.

- 
Complete Workflow Breakdown:
See how to build an automation that monitors incoming emails, checks token balances, classifies email content, drafts responses in multiple steps, and saves your email as a draft.
